Info magang dari Yuking & Co. Attorneys at Law

Yuking & Co. Attorneys at Law is currently looking for highly motivated Law Graduates to join our internship program. As a Legal Intern, you'll have the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a dynamic and fast-paced legal environment.

Job Requirements :
• Female
• Specifically for law students and law graduates
• Fluency in English is a must
• Able to work as a team or individually
• Having a good analytical, research and writing skills
• Preferable experience at the law firm/legal corporation.

Send your best CV at office@ync.co.id
Subject name : Legal Intern - Your Name
